title: Nextra Theme Schema
description: Schema defining customizable settings for Nextra theme.

site_name.title: Site Name
site_name.description: The site name displayed in the navigation and footer.

enable_custom_style.title: Enable Custom CSS Styles
enable_custom_style.description: Whether to override default theme CSS color and font style (warning: may break original design layout).

accent_color.title: Primary Accent Color
accent_color.description: Nextra theme primary accent styling color.

font_family.title: Typography Font Family
font_family.description: The default font-family used across pages.

hero_title.title: Hero Main Title
hero_title.description: Large text heading on front hero page.

hero_subtitle.default: Beautiful, simple and powerful static site generator.
hero_subtitle.title: Hero Subtitle Info
hero_subtitle.description: Sub-heading explanatory text on front page.

github_repo.title: GitHub Repository URL
github_repo.description: Provide a link to display a GitHub logo/link on navigation headers.

unstable_favicon_glyph.title: Favicon Emoji Glyph
unstable_favicon_glyph.description: Specify a single Emoji to dynamically serve as browser tab Favicon.
